  • Ajo
    • Retrieve Ajo data by Ajo ID. This endpoint retrieves details of an Ajo entry based on the provided Ajo ID. If the data is found, it returns the details along with a success message. If no data is found, it returns a not found message.
    • Invite users to an Ajo. This endpoint allows authenticated users to invite other users to join a specific Ajo group. It performs the following actions: 1. Validates if the number of invitations does not exceed the allowed member count for the Ajo. 2. Creates invitations for the provided users. 3. Calculates the payment schedules for the invited users based on the Ajo's frequency. 4. Interacts with an external API to create a product and get a product ID. 5. Generates invitation links for the users and sends them via email if they are not the authenticated user.
    • Create a new Ajo. This endpoint allows authenticated users to create a new Ajo. It requires various details about the Ajo, including its name, account number, description, frequency, member count, starting date, cycle, and the amount per member. Upon successful creation, a unique code is generated for the Ajo. The user ID of the authenticated user is associated with the newly created Ajo.
    • Get all Ajo created by the authenticated user. This endpoint retrieves all Ajo records created by the currently authenticated user. It supports pagination through the `per_page` query parameter, allowing clients to specify the number of records per page.
    • Get all Ajo invitations created by the authenticated user and invitations they have been added to. This endpoint retrieves: 1. A list of Ajo records where the authenticated user is the inviter, including details and total paid amounts. 2. A list of invitations where the authenticated user has been invited, including the details of the Ajo and invitation. Both lists are paginated through the `per_page` query parameter.
    • Retrieve users who have accepted the Ajo invitation but have not made a payment. This endpoint retrieves a list of users who have accepted an invitation to an Ajo but have not made a payment. It filters users based on their invitation status and checks if their payment date is in the future.
    • Process a payout request for an Ajo account. This endpoint allows a user to request a payout from their Ajo account. It performs various checks, applies charges, and interacts with an external service to handle the payout request.
    • Retrieve Ajo contributors by Ajo ID. This endpoint retrieves Ajo contributors for a specified Ajo ID. It first checks if there are invitations associated with the given Ajo ID. For each invitation, it retrieves Ajo contributors linked by `merchantReference`, groups them by `transactionReference`, and includes the associated email. It returns the grouped data along with a success message. If no data is found for the specified Ajo ID, it returns a not found message.
    • Retrieve the list of withdrawal transactions for the authenticated user. This endpoint retrieves all withdrawal transactions where the authenticated user is the beneficiary. The transactions are ordered by creation date in descending order.
    • API endpoints for ajo functionalities. Retrieve transaction data for an Ajo contributor.

  • Bank Management
    • Get NGN Banks List from External API This endpoint retrieves a list of Nigerian banks by making a request to an external API. It requires a valid authorization token, which is handled internally.
    • Update a bank. This endpoint allows the user to update the details of a specific bank account by providing the bank's ID. Only certain fields like `bankName` can be updated.
    • Add a new bank account to the user's profile. This endpoint allows the user to add a bank account by providing necessary details like bank name, account name, bank code, account number, and a reference ID. The method also checks if the account number already exists to prevent duplicates.
    • Get all bank accounts for the authenticated user. This endpoint retrieves all bank accounts that have been added by the authenticated user. It returns a list of all bank accounts associated with the user's ID.
    • Delete a bank. This endpoint allows the user to delete a specific bank account by providing the bank's ID.

Introduction

An End-to-End Payment System and Expense Management Solution

This documentation aims to provide all the information you need to work with our API.

This documentation, prepared by Sunday Ogedengbe Olaoluwa, Backend Engineer at Pethahiah Rehoboth International Limited, guides you on seamlessly integrating the API into any authorized platform. Code examples in various programming languages are available on the right (or within the content on mobile). Switch languages using the tabs at the top right (or from the nav menu on mobile).

Base URL

azatme.eduland.ng

Authenticating requests

This API is authenticated by sending an Authorization header with the value "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}".

All authenticated endpoints are marked with a requires authentication badge in the documentation below.

You can retrieve your token by visiting your dashboard and clicking Generate API token.

Admin

Get All Merchants

requires authentication

Retrieve a list of all registered merchants in the system.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "azatme.eduland.ng/api/allMerchants" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/allMerchants"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$response = $client->get(
    'azatme.eduland.ng/api/allMerchants',
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}',
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
    ]
);
$body = $response->getBody();
print_r(json_decode((string) $body));

Ajo

Retrieve Ajo data by Ajo ID. This endpoint retrieves details of an Ajo entry based on the provided Ajo ID. If the data is found, it returns the details along with a success message. If no data is found, it returns a not found message.

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "azatme.eduland.ng/api/get-ajo-by-id/AJO123456" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/get-ajo-by-id/AJO123456"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$response = $client->get(
    'azatme.eduland.ng/api/get-ajo-by-id/AJO123456',
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}',
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
    ]
);
$body = $response->getBody();
print_r(json_decode((string) $body));

Example response (200):

Request      

GET api/get-ajo-by-id/{ajoId}

URL Parameters

ajoId  string  

The unique ID of the Ajo entry.

Invite users to an Ajo. This endpoint allows authenticated users to invite other users to join a specific Ajo group. It performs the following actions: 1. Validates if the number of invitations does not exceed the allowed member count for the Ajo. 2. Creates invitations for the provided users. 3. Calculates the payment schedules for the invited users based on the Ajo's frequency. 4. Interacts with an external API to create a product and get a product ID. 5. Generates invitation links for the users and sends them via email if they are not the authenticated user.

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/invitation/1" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"users\": [
        \"explicabo\"
    ],
    \"productName\": \"\\\"Monthly Subscription\\\"\",
    \"productDescription\": \"\\\"A subscription for monthly services.\\\"\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/invitation/1"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "users": [
        "explicabo"
    ],
    "productName": "\"Monthly Subscription\"",
    "productDescription": "\"A subscription for monthly services.\""
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$response = $client->post(
    'azatme.eduland.ng/api/invitation/1',
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}',
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'json' => [
            'users' => [
                'explicabo',
            ],
            'productName' => '"Monthly Subscription"',
            'productDescription' => '"A subscription for monthly services."',
        ],
    ]
);
$body = $response->getBody();
print_r(json_decode((string) $body));

Create a new Ajo. This endpoint allows authenticated users to create a new Ajo. It requires various details about the Ajo, including its name, account number, description, frequency, member count, starting date, cycle, and the amount per member. Upon successful creation, a unique code is generated for the Ajo. The user ID of the authenticated user is associated with the newly created Ajo.

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/create-ajo" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"name\": \"\\\"Weekly Savings Club\\\"\",
    \"account_number\": \"\\\"1234567890\\\"\",
    \"description\": \"\\\"Ajo for weekly savings with community participation.\\\"\",
    \"frequency\": \"\\\"weekly\\\"\",
    \"member_count\": 20,
    \"starting_date\": \"\\\"2024-08-01\\\"\",
    \"cycle\": \"\\\"4 weeks\\\"\",
    \"amount_per_member\": 5000
}"

const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/create-ajo"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "name": "\"Weekly Savings Club\"",
    "account_number": "\"1234567890\"",
    "description": "\"Ajo for weekly savings with community participation.\"",
    "frequency": "\"weekly\"",
    "member_count": 20,
    "starting_date": "\"2024-08-01\"",
    "cycle": "\"4 weeks\"",
    "amount_per_member": 5000
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$response = $client->post(
    'azatme.eduland.ng/api/create-ajo',
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}',
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'json' => [
            'name' => '"Weekly Savings Club"',
            'account_number' => '"1234567890"',
            'description' => '"Ajo for weekly savings with community participation."',
            'frequency' => '"weekly"',
            'member_count' => 20,
            'starting_date' => '"2024-08-01"',
            'cycle' => '"4 weeks"',
            'amount_per_member' => 5000.0,
        ],
    ]
);
$body = $response->getBody();
print_r(json_decode((string) $body));

Retrieve Ajo contributors by Ajo ID. This endpoint retrieves Ajo contributors for a specified Ajo ID. It first checks if there are invitations associated with the given Ajo ID. For each invitation, it retrieves Ajo contributors linked by `merchantReference`, groups them by `transactionReference`, and includes the associated email. It returns the grouped data along with a success message. If no data is found for the specified Ajo ID, it returns a not found message.

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/update-mandate" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"mandateId\": 1,
    \"requestType\": \"\\\"Update\\\"\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/update-mandate"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "mandateId": 1,
    "requestType": "\"Update\""
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$response = $client->post(
    'azatme.eduland.ng/api/update-mandate',
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}',
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'json' => [
            'mandateId' => 1,
            'requestType' => '"Update"',
        ],
    ]
);
$body = $response->getBody();
print_r(json_decode((string) $body));

Example response (200):


{
    "message": "Mandate updated successfully",
    "mandate": {
        "id": 1,
        "status": "Updated"
    }
}

Example response (400):


{
    "error": {
        "mandateId": [
            "The mandate id field is required."
        ],
        "requestType": [
            "The request type field is required.",
            "The selected request type is invalid."
        ]
    }
}

Example response (500):


{
    "error": "Failed to update mandate. Please try again later."
}

Body Parameters

    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",

};

fetch(url, {

Upload and save a profile image for the authenticated user.

requires authentication

This endpoint allows the authenticated user to upload an image, which is then saved to the server's storage directory. The image file must be in one of the allowed formats (jpeg, png, jpg, gif). The image path is then saved in the user's profile.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/image" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --form "image=@/tmp/phpWDs3Dz" 
const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/image"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

const body = new FormData();
body.append('image', document.querySelector('input[name="image"]').files[0]);

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body,
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$response = $client->post(
    'azatme.eduland.ng/api/image',
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}',
            'Content-Type' => 'multipart/form-data',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'multipart' => [
            [
                'name' => 'image',
                'contents' => fopen('/tmp/phpWDs3Dz', 'r')
            ],
        ],
    ]
);
$body = $response->getBody();
print_r(json_decode((string) $body));

    }
}

Handle Ajo webhook response.

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/agowebhook" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"webhookData\": {
        \"status\": \"paid\",
        \"ajoId\": 1
    }
}"

const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/agowebhook"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "webhookData": {
        "status": "paid",
        "ajoId": 1
    }
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$response = $client->post(
    'azatme.eduland.ng/api/agowebhook',
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}',
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'json' => \Symfony\Component\VarExporter\Internal\Hydrator::hydrate(
            $o = [
                clone (\Symfony\Component\VarExporter\Internal\Registry::$prototypes['stdClass'] ?? \Symfony\Component\VarExporter\Internal\Registry::p('stdClass')),
            ],
            null,
            [
                'stdClass' => [
                    'status' => [
                        'paid',
                    ],
                    'ajoId' => [
                        1,
                    ],
                ],
            ],
            [
                'webhookData' => $o[0],
            ],
            []
        ),
    ]
);
$body = $response->getBody();
print_r(json_decode((string) $body));

Example response (200):

    "message": "Webhook processed successfully."
}

    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"status\": \"resolved\",
    \"notes\": \"Issue resolved after updating payment details.\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/admin/update-feedback/CR123456"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "status": "resolved",
    "notes": "Issue resolved after updating payment details."
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "PUT",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

$response = $client->put(

            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'json' => [

            'notes' => 'Issue resolved after updating payment details.',

);

Process payments for a business using MPOS.

It validates the input data, checks business existence, processes payments through an external service, and saves the transaction details in the database.

    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/mpos-payment/ut" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \

Create a Product or Multiple Products

requires authentication

This method creates one or multiple products based on the request data. It accepts an array of products or a single product's details, creates the product(s), and assigns a common unique code to each product in the array. It ensures the authenticated user is assigned as the owner of the product(s).

If $products is an array, it creates multiple products with a common unique code. If $products is not an array, it creates a single product with its own unique code.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/create-product" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"products\": [
        \"qui\"
    ],
    \"name\": \"tenetur\",
    \"description\": \"distinctio\",
    \"business_code\": \"recusandae\",
    \"category_id\": 8,
    \"subcategory_id\": 12,
    \"amount\": 5.350861,
    \"quantity\": 19
}"

const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/create-product"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "products": [
        "qui"
    ],
    "name": "tenetur",
    "description": "distinctio",
    "business_code": "recusandae",
    "category_id": 8,
    "subcategory_id": 12,
    "amount": 5.350861,
    "quantity": 19
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$response = $client->post(
    'azatme.eduland.ng/api/create-product',
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}',
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'json' => [
            'products' => [
                'qui',
            ],
            'name' => 'tenetur',
            'description' => 'distinctio',
            'business_code' => 'recusandae',
            'category_id' => 8,
            'subcategory_id' => 12,
            'amount' => 5.350861,
            'quantity' => 19,
        ],
    ]
);
$body = $response->getBody();
print_r(json_decode((string) $body));

Get All Products for the Authenticated Merchant

requires authentication

    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/all-product"
);

const params = {
    "per_page": "9",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$response = $client->get(
    'azatme.eduland.ng/api/all-product',
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}',
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'query' => [

);

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/initiate-business-transaction/deserunt" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"email\": \"\\\"customer@example.com\\\"\",
    \"unique_code\": \"[\\\"ABC123\\\", \\\"XYZ789\\\"]\",
    \"quantity\": \"[1, 2]\",
    \"moto_id\": 1,
    \"bankName\": \"\\\"Bank of Example\\\"\",
    \"bankCode\": \"\\\"123456\\\"\",
    \"account_number\": \"\\\"000123456789\\\"\",
    \"due_days\": 30
}"

const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/initiate-business-transaction/deserunt"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "email": "\"customer@example.com\"",
    "unique_code": "[\"ABC123\", \"XYZ789\"]",
    "quantity": "[1, 2]",
    "moto_id": 1,
    "bankName": "\"Bank of Example\"",
    "bankCode": "\"123456\"",
    "account_number": "\"000123456789\"",
    "due_days": 30
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$response = $client->post(
    'azatme.eduland.ng/api/initiate-business-transaction/deserunt',
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}',
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'json' => [
            'email' => '"customer@example.com"',
            'unique_code' => '["ABC123", "XYZ789"]',
            'quantity' => '[1, 2]',
            'moto_id' => 1,
            'bankName' => '"Bank of Example"',
            'bankCode' => '"123456"',
            'account_number' => '"000123456789"',

Process a business withdrawal request and handle transaction settlement.

requires authentication

This endpoint processes a withdrawal request by applying charges and settling the transaction, updating the residual amount, and saving withdrawal details.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/business-settlements" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"amount\": 5000,
    \"account_number\": \"\\\"000123456789\\\"\",
    \"description\": \"\\\"Business collection\\\"\",
    \"bank\": \"\\\"Bank of Example\\\"\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/business-settlements"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "amount": 5000,
    "account_number": "\"000123456789\"",
    "description": "\"Business collection\"",
    "bank": "\"Bank of Example\""
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$response = $client->post(
    'azatme.eduland.ng/api/business-settlements',
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}',
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'json' => [
            'amount' => 5000,
            'account_number' => '"000123456789"',
            'description' => '"Business collection"',
            'bank' => '"Bank of Example"',
        ],
    ]
);
$body = $response->getBody();
print_r(json_decode((string) $body));

    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"first_name\": \"et\",
    \"last_name\": \"et\",
    \"address\": \"nihil\",
    \"nimc\": \"rem\",
    \"bvn\": \"ratione\",
    \"country\": \"et\",
    \"state\": \"ut\",
    \"age\": \"error\",
    \"gender\": \"at\",
    \"dob\": \"quas\",
    \"lga_of_origin\": \"expedita\",
    \"maiden_name\": \"ea\"
}"

    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/updateProfile"
);

    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "first_name": "et",

    "address": "nihil",
    "nimc": "rem",
    "bvn": "ratione",
    "country": "et",
    "state": "ut",
    "age": "error",
    "gender": "at",
    "dob": "quas",
    "lga_of_origin": "expedita",
    "maiden_name": "ea"
};

}).then(response => response.json());

        'headers' => [

        ],
        'json' => [
            'first_name' => 'et',
            'last_name' => 'et',
            'address' => 'nihil',
            'nimc' => 'rem',
            'bvn' => 'ratione',
            'country' => 'et',

            'gender' => 'at',

Update the status of an issue.

requires authentication

This endpoint allows updating the status of a complaint based on the provided complain reference code. If the reference code is found, the status is updated, and a success message is returned. Otherwise, an error message is returned indicating that the reference code was not found.

Example request:
curl --request PUT \
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/user/update/status/&quot;ABCD1234&quot;" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"status\": \"\\\"resolved\\\"\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/user/update/status/&quot;ABCD1234&quot;"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "status": "\"resolved\""
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "PUT",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$response = $client->put(
    'azatme.eduland.ng/api/user/update/status/&quot;ABCD1234&quot;',
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}',
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'json' => [
            'status' => '"resolved"',
        ],
    ]
);
$body = $response->getBody();
print_r(json_decode((string) $body));

Example response (200):


{
    "message": "Status updated to successfully",
    "data": {
        "complain_reference_code": "ABCD1234",
        "status": "resolved"
    }
}

KYC Management

Update KYC Profile.

requires authentication

This endpoint allows Azatme merchant/sponsor user types to update their KYC (Know Your Customer) profile. The merchant/sponsor must provide their business registration number for automatic verification or upload files for manual verification. All parameters are required to ensure a complete KYC profile update.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/kyc/update" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --form "business_registration_number=RC123456" \
    --form "automatic_verification=1" \
    --form "identity_card=@/tmp/php7kINwC" \
    --form "utility_bill=@/tmp/phpBhw9fy" \
    --form "proof_of_address=@/tmp/php3vIm6y" \
    --form "business_registration_certificate=@/tmp/phpqsskyy" 
const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/kyc/update"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

const body = new FormData();
body.append('business_registration_number', 'RC123456');
body.append('automatic_verification', '1');
body.append('identity_card', document.querySelector('input[name="identity_card"]').files[0]);
body.append('utility_bill', document.querySelector('input[name="utility_bill"]').files[0]);
body.append('proof_of_address', document.querySelector('input[name="proof_of_address"]').files[0]);
body.append('business_registration_certificate', document.querySelector('input[name="business_registration_certificate"]').files[0]);

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body,
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$response = $client->post(
    'azatme.eduland.ng/api/kyc/update',
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}',
            'Content-Type' => 'multipart/form-data',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'multipart' => [
            [
                'name' => 'business_registration_number',
                'contents' => 'RC123456'
            ],
            [
                'name' => 'automatic_verification',
                'contents' => '1'
            ],
            [
                'name' => 'identity_card',
                'contents' => fopen('/tmp/php7kINwC', 'r')
            ],
            [
                'name' => 'utility_bill',
                'contents' => fopen('/tmp/phpBhw9fy', 'r')
            ],
            [
                'name' => 'proof_of_address',
                'contents' => fopen('/tmp/php3vIm6y', 'r')
            ],
            [
                'name' => 'business_registration_certificate',
                'contents' => fopen('/tmp/phpqsskyy', 'r')
            ],
        ],
    ]
);
$body = $response->getBody();
print_r(json_decode((string) $body));

Example response (200):

curl --request GET \

const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/get-draft-refundme"
);

const params = {
    "per_page": "10",
    "page": "1",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

    'azatme.eduland.ng/api/get-draft-refundme',

            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'query' => [
            'per_page'=> '10',
            'page'=> '1',
        ],
    ]
);
$body = $response->getBody();
print_r(json_decode((string) $body));

Users Authentication

API endpoints for user management. Register a new user.

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/register" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"name\": \"John Doe\",
    \"email\": \"user@example.com\",
    \"usertype\": \"user\",
    \"company_name\": \"debitis\",
    \"phone\": \"repellendus\",
    \"password\": \"yourpassword\",
    \"password_confirmation\": \"yourpassword\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "azatme.eduland.ng/api/register"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "name": "John Doe",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "usertype": "user",
    "company_name": "debitis",
    "phone": "repellendus",
    "password": "yourpassword",
    "password_confirmation": "yourpassword"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$response = $client->post(
    'azatme.eduland.ng/api/register',
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}',
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'json' => [
            'name' => 'John Doe',
            'email' => 'user@example.com',
            'usertype' => 'user',
            'company_name' => 'debitis',
            'phone' => 'repellendus',
            'password' => 'yourpassword',
            'password_confirmation' => 'yourpassword',
        ],
    ]
);
$body = $response->getBody();
print_r(json_decode((string) $body));
